# Upstream A2UI schemas

The two JSON files in this directory are unmodified copies from the [A2UI project](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui), commit `36db592849afdc5455b8959752a3009163bb3415`, paths `specification/v0_9_1/json/server_to_client.json` and `specification/v0_9_1/json/client_to_server.json`. They are distributed under the upstream Apache-2.0 license; see the repository's root `LICENSE`. They are used as pinned test fixtures, not as a claim of complete A2UI conformance.
